theorems.name: Submission.ecf_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_parametrization
theorems.statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1)) (F : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid (k + 1))) (g : ℕ → Euclid (k + 1) → ℤ), (∀ j, ∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (F j)) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) → (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) → (∀ j, IntegrableOn (fun u => (g j u : ℝ)) (A j)) → ∑' j, ∫⁻ u in A j, ‖(g j u : ℝ)‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))))) ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), HasSum (fun j => ∫ u in A j, (g j u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) (F j u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (T ω)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
